    assert utils.url_quote('https://foo bar') == 'https%3A%2F%2Ffoo+bar'

def test_urlencode():
    f = utils.urlencode
    assert f({}) == '', 'empty dict'
    assert f([]) == '', 'empty list'
    assert f({'q': 'hello'}) == 'q=hello', 'basic dict'
    assert f({'q': ''}) == 'q=', 'empty param value'
    assert f({'q': None}) == 'q=None', 'None param value'
    assert f([('q', 'hello')]) == 'q=hello', 'basic list'
    assert f([('x', '3'), ('x', '5')]) == 'x=3&x=5', 'list with multi keys'
    assert f({'q': 'a b c'}) == 'q=a+b+c', 'handles spaces'
    assert f({'q': 'a$$'}) == 'q=a%24%24', 'handles special ascii chars'

Fixed `/lists/add` input handling. When a form body is present, the list is built from its URL-encoded values without merging query parameters. Defaults no longer conflict with indexed seed fields, invalid seeds are ignored, and later assignments win during unflattening.

The relevant tests pass: **17 passed**. Ruff and `git diff --check` also pass.
